options.query:
index=dns_soc_aws sourcetype=aws:s3 earliest=-24h
| spath
| rename answers{}.Rdata as answer_ip
| where query_type="A" AND rcode="NOERROR" AND isnotnull(answer_ip)
| eval query_name=lower(rtrim(query_name,"."))
| mvexpand answer_ip
| eval bucket=_time
| bin bucket span=5m
| fields bucket query_name answer_ip
| dedup bucket query_name answer_ip

| join type=inner max=0 bucket answer_ip [
    search index=dns_soc_aws sourcetype=aws:cloudwatchlogs:vpcflow earliest=-24h
    src_ip="10.50.30.20"
    | where NOT cidrmatch("10.0.0.0/8",dest_ip)
        AND NOT cidrmatch("172.16.0.0/12",dest_ip)
        AND NOT cidrmatch("192.168.0.0/16",dest_ip)
    | eval bucket=_time
    | bin bucket span=5m
    | rename dest_ip as answer_ip
    | fields bucket src_ip answer_ip
]

| stats count as matched_connections dc(answer_ip) as unique_matched_ips
  by bucket query_name src_ip

| where unique_matched_ips>=2 AND matched_connections>=3
| lookup fastflux_benign_domains.csv query_name OUTPUT reason as benign_reason
| where isnull(benign_reason)
| rename bucket as _time
| timechart span=5m sum(matched_connections) as "Matched Connections"

index=dns_soc_aws sourcetype=aws:s3 earliest=-30m
| spath
| rename answers{}.Rdata as answer_ip
| where query_type="A" AND rcode="NOERROR" AND isnotnull(answer_ip)
| eval query_name=lower(rtrim(query_name,"."))
| mvexpand answer_ip
| search query_name="flux.soclab.abdul4rehman215.tech"
| stats dc(answer_ip) as unique_rotating_ips

index=dns_soc_aws sourcetype=aws:s3 earliest=-24h
| spath
| rename answers{}.Rdata as answer_ip
| where query_type="A" AND rcode="NOERROR" AND isnotnull(answer_ip)
| eval query_name=lower(rtrim(query_name,"."))
| mvexpand answer_ip
| search query_name="flux.soclab.abdul4rehman215.tech"
| stats count as dns_answers
        min(_time) as first_seen
        max(_time) as last_seen
  by answer_ip
| convert ctime(first_seen) ctime(last_seen)
| sort - dns_answers

index=dns_soc_ai earliest=-24h
"Suspicious Fast Flux DNS Behavior"
| spath
| sort - _time
| table
    _time
    alert.alert_name
    ai.summary
    ai.confidence

index=dns_soc_ai earliest=-24h
"Suspicious Fast Flux DNS Behavior"
| spath
| sort - _time
| head 1
| eval detection_name="Suspicious Fast Flux DNS Behavior"
| eval severity="Medium"
| eval mitre_technique="T1568.001"
| eval mitre_name="Dynamic Resolution: Fast Flux DNS"
| eval detection_window="5 minutes"
| eval tuning="Benign dynamic domains excluded via lookup"
| table detection_name severity mitre_technique mitre_name detection_window tuning

description: Detection engineering dashboard for Fast Flux DNS behavior, DNS answer churn, matched network connections, alerting, and AI-assisted triage.
title: Scenario 03 - Fast Flux DNS Detection
